description: This file contains serialization, surrogate, and copying logic for the ConcurrentQueue<T> type within the Orleans.Serialization framework. It defines a serializer class, a surrogate struct, and a deep copier class for ConcurrentQueue<T>.

classes.name: ConcurrentQueueCodec<T>

classes.description: Surrogate type used for serializing ConcurrentQueue<T>.

methods.description: Converts a ConcurrentQueue<T> to its surrogate form.
